hypotheses.justification: It is implied by the other hypotheses. K is a Field with Algebra A K and IsFractionRing A K. IsFractionRing.injective (Mathlib/RingTheory/Localization/FractionRing.lean, for any CommRing) makes algebraMap A K injective, and the file has an instance FaithfulSMul A K from IsFractionRing. IsDomain.of_faithfulSMul (Mathlib/Algebra/Algebra/Basic.lean) with IsDomain K from Field then gives IsDomain A. The statement never needs IsDomain A to elaborate: IsIntegrallyClosed A is an abbrev for IsIntegrallyClosedIn A (FractionRing A) and needs only CommRing, and ResidueField, Module.Finite, Module.Flat, IsFractionRing and IsAlgClosed need no IsDomain A either. The proof changes only by adding `haveI : IsDomain A := IsDomain.of_faithfulSMul A K` at the start. The GenLift helper lemmas take [IsDomain A] as a binder, and this local instance supplies it. The rest of the proof is unchanged, so the theorem remains true and provable without the binder.
